title: Add analytics dashboard with revenue trends, service categories, and top performers charts

requirements.summary: Integrate Recharts library for line, pie, and bar charts with animations
acceptanceCriteria: Charting library is installed and configured
Library supports responsive charts
Library works with existing React Query data flows
Charts render without layout issues on mobile and desktop

file_operations.description: Add recharts library as a dependency to support line charts, pie charts, and bar charts with animation capabilities

requirements.summary: Compute revenue trends data from existing analytics hook by aggregating payment data over time periods
acceptanceCriteria: Revenue data is computed from existing payments or projects data
Data is grouped by time period (daily, weekly, or monthly)
Computation handles empty or missing data gracefully
Data structure matches chart component requirements

file_operations.description: Create utility function to aggregate payment data from useAgencyAnalytics hook into time-series format (daily or weekly) for the revenue trends line chart. Handle empty data gracefully and return an array of {date: string, revenue: number} objects suitable for Recharts LineChart

Create utility function to aggregate services by niche from useAgencyAnalytics data, computing count and revenue per category. Return an array of {category: string, count: number, revenue: number} objects for Recharts PieChart or BarChart

Create utility function to rank services by revenue or sales count from useAgencyAnalytics data, returning the top 5-10 performers as an array of {name: string, value: number} objects for Recharts BarChart

requirements.summary: Add revenue trends over time line chart showing daily or weekly revenue progression
acceptanceCriteria: Line chart displays revenue data over a time period (e.g., last 30 days)
Chart uses the existing gradient theme colors (teal green primary, electric blue accent)
Chart animates on initial load
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component with appropriate title

file_operations.description: Create a RevenueTrendsChart component that uses Recharts LineChart to display revenue over time. Fetch data via useAgencyAnalytics, compute trends using computeRevenueTrends utility, apply gradient theme colors (#00b3a4 teal green, #00f0ff electric blue), enable animations, wrap in ChartBlock with title 'Revenue Trends', and handle loading/error states

requirements.summary: Add service categories distribution chart showing breakdown by niche or category
acceptanceCriteria: Pie chart or bar chart shows services grouped by niche or category
Chart displays count or revenue per category
Chart uses gradient theme colors consistently
Chart animates on load and updates
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component

file_operations.description: Create a ServiceCategoriesChart component using Recharts PieChart to show service distribution by niche. Fetch data via useAgencyAnalytics, compute categories using computeServiceCategories utility, apply gradient theme colors, enable animations, wrap in ChartBlock with title 'Service Categories', and handle loading/error states

requirements.summary: Add top performers chart ranking services by revenue or conversion metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Bar chart or ranking list shows top 5-10 performers
Chart displays either top services by revenue or top-converting leads
Chart uses gradient theme styling
Chart animates on load
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component with descriptive title

file_operations.description: Create a TopPerformersChart component using Recharts BarChart to display top 5-10 services ranked by revenue. Fetch data via useAgencyAnalytics, compute rankings using computeTopPerformers utility, apply gradient theme colors, enable animations with animationDuration, wrap in ChartBlock with title 'Top Performers', and handle loading/error states

requirements.summary: Update AnalyticsPage layout to display three new charts in responsive grid below existing metrics cards
acceptanceCriteria: Charts are arranged in a clean grid layout
Layout is responsive on mobile and desktop
Charts maintain gradient theme styling
Existing metrics cards remain visible above charts
Loading and error states are handled for all charts

file_operations.description: Update AnalyticsPage to import and render RevenueTrendsChart, ServiceCategoriesChart, and TopPerformersChart below the existing metrics cards. Arrange the three charts in a responsive grid using Tailwind grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Preserve all existing metrics cards and layout structure. Ensure gradient theme styling is maintained across all charts and the page handles loading/error states gracefully
